messages.author: ff42271ef6191bca
messages.subject: How to change point shape
parts:
Hi,

I have a function which should get an optional parameter "shape"
defining the shape of the points. I would like to call the function
using a parameter like "shape='square'".

How do i change the shape of the data points within the function?
Additionally, i found that the default shape is 16, but i could not
find a list of shapes.

Thanks for help,
Herbert
------------------
PlotPts <- function (Pts, shape) {
theme_set(theme_bw())
p <- ggplot(Pts, aes(x, y)) + geom_point(aes(size=Size, colour=Col,
fill=Col))

p <- p + scale_area(limits=c(0,1), to=c(0,15))
p <- p + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = NA) +
scale_y_continuous(breaks = NA) +
opts(plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,-1,-1), "lines")) +
opts(panel.background = theme_blank(), panel.border = theme_blank())
+
opts(legend.position='none')
print(p)
}

p1 <- data.frame(x=c(randomNumbers(60,0,100,1)/100),y=c(randomNumbers
(60,0,100,1)/100),Size=c(randomNumbers(60,0,100,1)/100),Col=rep(c
('red','green','blue'),20))
PlotPts(p1, shape='square')
------------------

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: How to change point shape
parts:
Hi,


A minimal example might be,

foo = function(shape="square"){

pch = switch(shape,
'square' = 0,
'cross' = 3,
'round' = 1,
'triangle' = 2)

qplot(1,1, shape = pch)
}

print(foo())

the default shapes are the following,

ScaleShapeDiscrete$output_set

(if (.$solid) {
c(16, 17, 15, 3, 7, 8)
}
else {
c(1, 2, 0, 3, 7, 8)
})[1:length(.$input_set())]

where the numbers are the same as in ?points

HTH,

baptiste
